xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.88.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5469: docs: planning and xBRIEF plans

metadata.sizeJustification: Six doc files only. lintProjectedSurface counts the first two path segments as a subsystem, so each root-level doc file (features/planning.mdx, features/swarm.mdx, docs.json, ...) counts as its own subsystem; the real surface is one docs site.

narratives.Problem: Overdeck has no user-facing docs page for planning. The facts live in developer docs (docs/XBRIEF.md, docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md), the changelog and CLI help, and two published pages (cli/workspace-commands.mdx, reference/state-model.mdx) still describe the retired .planning/ directory, a dolt-backed task store and a Docker checkbox that is on by default.
narratives.Proposal: Write features/planning.mdx from the verified fact sheet in the PRD (.pan/drafts/PAN-5469.md, F-1 to F-46): the Plan dialog and pan plan, PRD drafts and specs in .pan/, the xBRIEF checklist, pan task, plan integrity, the plan critic and roles.plan.sub.critic.model, pan plan finalize, pan scope, and when to skip planning. Add it to the Features group in docs.json, and link it from features/swarm.mdx, configuration/effort.mdx, reference/state-model.mdx and cli/workspace-commands.mdx, correcting the stale planning claims on those pages.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No source code changes (pan scope help text is PAN-5487; the Plan dialog Stop buttons are PAN-5488)
- No edits to concepts.mdx or introduction.mdx (PAN-5472)
- No edits to features/issue-pipeline.mdx (PAN-5468 adds the reverse link)
- No docs.json changes beyond inserting features/planning (PAN-5483 owns the restructure)
- No changes to docs/XBRIEF.md, docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md or docs/VBRIEF.md
- No new screenshots and no invented UI
- No description of the Plan dialog Shadow Engineering checkbox
- No changelog.d entry
- No new CLI reference page for pan plan or pan task (PAN-5478)

autoDecisions.summary: Page title is 'Planning: PRDs, xBRIEF plans and the plan critic' with a 145-character description
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for a specific, searchable title; this names the three things people search for and fits the 50 to 160 character description rule.

autoDecisions.summary: pan scope is documented by the code's behavior (status fields rewritten in place), not by its stale --help text; PAN-5487 filed to fix the help
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says claims must match code and --help, and here they disagree. The code is what users get; the help fix is code, out of scope for a docs-only issue.

autoDecisions.summary: Stale planning claims on the four linking pages are corrected, not only linked
autoDecisions.rationale: Linking from a page that contradicts the new page sends readers to two opposite answers; the corrections are limited to planning claims on those pages.

autoDecisions.summary: features/issue-pipeline.mdx is not edited; PAN-5468 was asked in a comment to add the reverse link
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5468 runs later in lane A, so the file will not exist when this issue runs; editing it would also collide with that issue's work.

autoDecisions.summary: docs.json: insert features/planning after features/issue-pipeline if present, else first in the Features group; on conflict take main's file and re-apply
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5483 restructures docs.json and PAN-5468 also inserts at the top of Features; a re-apply rule resolves any landing order deterministically.

autoDecisions.summary: The Plan dialog section omits Shadow Engineering and steers users to the footer Stop (abort) and Done (accept), not the header Stop; PAN-5488 filed
autoDecisions.rationale: Shadow Engineering only writes a stub file and PAN-5472 is verifying it; the header Stop completes planning despite its label, so recommending it would mislead users.
No planning screenshot exists under images/, and the issue forbids inventing UI.
